columns.name: Created Date
columns.description: The date and time the 311 service request was created

columns.name: CaseNumber
columns.description: The unique case reference number for each 311 service request

columns.name: Department
columns.description: The department or agency that the 311 service request was referred to

columns.name: Division
columns.description: The division that the 311 service request was referred to

columns.name: Type
columns.description: The specific type of 311 service request

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The status of the 311 service request

columns.name: StatusDescription
columns.description: The status description of the 311 service request

columns.name: Closed Date
columns.description: The date and time the case created by the 311 service request was closed by the responsible department

columns.name: PropertyID
columns.description: A unique geographic identifier tied to a 311 service request, typically an SBL number

columns.name: ReportedLocation
columns.description: The location as reported on the 311 service request

columns.name: Assessed Number
columns.description: The house number of the address associated with the 311 request

columns.name: AssessedStreet
columns.description: The street associated with the 311 request

columns.name: Street
columns.description: The street associated with the 311 request

columns.name: Secondary Street
columns.description: An optional secondary street associated with the 311 request

columns.name: City
columns.description: The city where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: State
columns.description: The state where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: The 5-digit zip code where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The latitude associated with the 311 service request

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The longitude associated with the 311 service request

columns.name: Duplicate Request
columns.description: An identifier for duplicate service requests

columns.name: Council District
columns.description: The council district where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located. District boundaries effective Jan 1, 2024.

columns.name: PlanningNeighborhood
columns.description: The planning neighborhood where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: PlanningSector
columns.description: The planning sector where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: PoliceDistrict
columns.description: The police district where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: Census Tract
columns.description: The census tract where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: Census Block Group
columns.description: The census block group where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located

columns.name: Census Block
columns.description: The census block where the property referenced in the 311 service request is located
